method: Read-only log phase analysis + Import.py orchestration source + asset mtime analysis.

correction_to_v1.error: In v1 I treated the 13 'Commandlet:' lines at the end of the log as evidence of completed commandlet phases.
correction_to_v1.reality: Those lines are inside the Python CalledProcessError traceback text embedded in the log. They are source-code context lines from Import.py showing variable values, NOT UE log output. They prove which command was in flight, not which phases completed.
correction_to_v1.lesson: Multi-line tracebacks interleaved into the log must not be parsed as engine events.

confirmed_phase_structure.orchestration: Import.py:740-755 runs per batch: import_assets(do_tiles=1) -> import_assets(do_tiles=0) -> move_assets_commandlet -> prepare_maps_commandlet_for_cooking -> load_asset_materials_commandlet -> build_binary_for_tm
confirmed_phase_structure.move_assets_commandlet: Import.py:771 invokes UE4 commandlet 'MoveAssets' with -PackageName=<pkg> -Maps=<names>. This is CARLA's asset relink step and is the prime candidate for relocating building meshes into /Game/<pkg>/Static/Terrain/<MapName>/.
confirmed_phase_structure.batching: Import.py:740-742 with args.batch_size -> 13 'Building Assets For Windows' starts observed at 00:18, 00:23, 00:26, 00:28, 00:31, 14:30, 14:59, 15:23, 15:26, 15:28, 15:31, 15:33, 15:35

log_evidence: LogTemp: Warning: Could not find TilesInfo.txt file
NEW_P0_defect_missing_tilesinfo.impact: TilesInfo.txt is the tile-discovery input consumed by the large-map path (referenced in PrepareAssetsForCookingCommandlet.cpp and LoadAssetMaterialsCommandlet.cpp). It is absent, so tile enumeration has no authoritative source.
NEW_P0_defect_missing_tilesinfo.status: NOT_INVESTIGATED_FURTHER - identified this batch, not yet root-caused

large_map_zero_tiles_CONFIRMED.log_evidence: line 18576 [15:20:59] LogCarla: Warning: Generating Large Map ; line 18577 [15:20:59] GenerateMap num Tiles generated 0
large_map_zero_tiles_CONFIRMED.mechanism: LargeMapManager.cpp:430 GenerateMap(InAssetsPath) loads UWorld assets and keeps only names containing '_Tile_'
large_map_zero_tiles_CONFIRMED.conclusion: Confirmed root cause for 'zero tiles': the tile streaming-level maps do not exist. Ingolstadt therefore has NO tile sublevels, and LargeMap renders no Ingolstadt geometry regardless of mesh reference resolution.

asset_write_timing.interpretation: ALL 5711 assets were written inside a single ~89 second burst, not spread across the 16.7 h run. That is inconsistent with per-tile progressive importing and instead indicates ONE bulk operation over all 20 tiles.
asset_write_timing.candidate_mechanism: The MoveAssets commandlet, or a single import batch covering all tiles, performing a bulk relocate of previously imported meshes.
asset_write_timing.conflicting_evidence: MoveAssets is invoked per batch AFTER import_assets completes. The final batch (started 15:35:31) never emitted a Success marker, i.e. it did not complete. Whether MoveAssets ran within that window is NOT established by the log.
asset_write_timing.status: OBSERVATION_ONLY - the 89 s burst is measured fact; its cause is not yet identified

what_remains_unproven: Which exact invocation wrote the 5711 meshes and with what DestinationPath.

Whether the 5711 broken references were ever persisted to disk in any saved asset. Evidence so far says NO: Ingolstadt.umap contains zero Ingolstadt_Tile_X_Y_ references and is far too small to hold them, and no tile .umap exists.

Whether MoveAssets rewrites references when it relocates meshes (it should, via UE4 rename/redirect), which would make the observed reference paths an in-flight artifact rather than a persisted defect.

decisive_next_experiment.name: single_tile_clean_import
steps: 1. Import ONE small tile (e.g. Ingolstadt_Tile_9_6, 8 buildings) to completion, with MoveAssets enabled as in production.
2. Record whether Ingolstadt_Tile_9_6.umap is written under Content/Ingolstadt/Maps/Ingolstadt/.
3. Extract /Game strings from that .umap and record the reference root it uses for its building meshes.
4. Record the on-disk location of those meshes after MoveAssets.
5. Compare: reference root == mesh location => no standing defect; reference root != mesh location => producer defect confirmed.
decisive_next_experiment.why_this_is_the_only_way: Both remaining hypotheses predict the same persisted state today, because the run was interrupted before any map could be saved. Only a completed single-tile run discriminates them.
decisive_next_experiment.cost: Minutes, versus a 16.7 h full import.

fix_direction.FIX_B_prime: CORRECT DIRECTION but must not be applied until single_tile_clean_import discriminates the two hypotheses
fix_direction.new_precondition: TilesInfo.txt must exist and be regenerated before tile discovery can work at all
